752:t_2:3.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「$c! We'll fight alongside you too!」

752:t_2:4.en:
$$カガリ$$
「Let our hopes become part of your strength too!」

752:t_2:5.en:
$$扇$$
「We believe in you! In your victory!」

752:t_2:6.en:
$$星刻$$
「Even if we can't stand on the battlefield with you, our hearts are with you!」

752:t_2:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「That's right! You are our hope!」

752:t_2:8.en:
$$アルベルト$$
「I'm counting on you! I'm counting on you, everyone! I believe in the future too, you know!」

752:t_2:9.en:
$$コーネリア$$
「You are our pride, and...」

752:t_2:11.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「So there is nothing to be afraid of!」

752:t_2:12.en:
$$マリナ$$
「If we have you... If we have $c with us, then...」

752:t_2:16.en:
$$ミラ$$
「I have confirmed that every $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ is operating normally. The $$ラース・バビロン$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$ is also running stably.」

752:t_2:17.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Good work, $$ミラ$$. Thanks to you joining us, Earth's super-dimensional physics has made incredible progress.」

752:t_2:18.en:
$$百目鬼$$
「Right now, the feelings of everyone on this Earth are becoming one through the $$レイライン$$ and the $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!」

752:t_2:19.en:
$$ロイド$$
「The $$蒼の地球$$ and $$翠の地球$$, the colonies, the Moon, Mars... Anyway, all of it.」

752:t_2:20.en:
$$セシル$$
「That draws out the $$地球の次元力$$ and becomes the power of $c!」

752:t_2:21.en:
$$敷島$$
「This is the best we can do!」

752:t_2:22.en:
$$弓$$
「But you guys will surely pull it off!」

752:t_2:30.en:
$$ロシウ$$
「You have always carved out the future!」

752:t_2:31.en:
$$キノン$$
「So I'm sure you will this time, too!」

752:t_2:32.en:
$$リジット$$
「The future of the $$翠の地球$$ and the $$蒼の地球$$ now rests on your shoulders!」

752:t_2:33.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「We're counting on you! Our hearts are with you guys, too!」

752:t_2:35.en:
$$キヤル$$
「Don't you lose, $c! Fight on, $$大グレン団$$!」

752:t_2:41.en:
$$つばさ$$
「It will be all right, $$静子$$. $c will surely come through.」

752:t_2:46.en:
$$ナミダ$$
「We'll cheer for you with everything we've got, too!」

752:t_2:52.en:
$$サチ子$$
「Big Bro, everyone at the company!」

752:t_2:55.en:
$$加代$$
「We'll keep waiting for you, always and forever!」

752:t_2:56.en:
$$梅江$$
「So you come back alive, you hear!」

752:t_2:57.en:
$$源五郎$$
「Protect the future of this universe!」

752:t_2:58.en:
$$兵左衛門$$
「Fight it out to the end! With everything you've got!」

752:t_2:59.en:
$$梅本$$
「I believe in it. The power that you and your robots create.」

752:t_2:65.en:
$$ゴウト$$
「We've come this far, so steel your nerves! We're giving it everything too!」

752:t_2:66.en:
$$キデーラ$$
「Yeah! I don't know if it's spirit quanta or life force, but take as much as you like!」

752:t_2:67.en:
$$ポタリア$$
「This is the fight we can put up!」

752:t_2:68.en:
$$フィアナ$$
($$キリコ$$... Be sure to... come back...)

752:t_2:73.en:
$$城田$$
「Yes. They will surely do it.」

752:t_2:74.en:
$$神村$$
「I believe in them, with all my heart.」

752:t_2:75.en:
$$大河内$$
「That's right. They are the ones who will carry the future.」

752:t_2:79.en:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「Humanity is becoming one right now, isn't it?」

752:t_2:80.en:
$$ハヤト$$
「The light in people's hearts will surely illuminate the future.」

752:t_2:81.en:
$$カイ$$
「This ought to get the times moving, too. That is, if there's anything beyond this.」

752:t_2:85.en:
$$サリィ$$
「This power is what humanity has gained, beyond war...」

752:t_2:86.en:
$$レディ$$
「Yes... It is something humanity won with its own hands.」

752:t_2:87.en:
$$マリーメイア$$
「And it is something that everyone shares.」

752:t_2:93.en:
$$オルバ$$
「I don't like it. Us asking someone for something.」

752:t_2:94.en:
$$シャギア$$
「But we have no choice but to acknowledge their power.」

752:t_2:96.en:
$$シャギア$$
「Heh... Let's entrust this to them. Our future as well.」

752:t_2:100.en:
$$サイアム$$
「If it's them, they will surely do it...」

752:t_2:102.en:
$$サイアム$$
「The future is almost here...」

752:t_2:106.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「$$ロラン$$! Earth is a really wonderful place! Hurry up and come back!!」

752:t_2:107.en:
$$ソシエ$$
「If you don't come back, I won't forgive you!」

752:t_2:108.en:
$$キエル$$
「It will be all right, $$ソシエ$$. $$ロラン$$ is not someone who would break a promise.」

752:t_2:110.en:
$$グエン$$
「You believe in them, don't you?」

752:t_2:115.en:
$$エンジェル$$
(The last page of '$$メトロポリス$$'...)

752:t_2:116.en:
$$エンジェル$$
(You are the ones who will fill it in)

kept_omissions: 752:t_2:59: Umemoto (gender unknown) - 信じているぞ has no object in Japanese; rendered 'I believe in it. The power ...' with no pronoun for the speaker's gender.
752:t_2:9/10: Cornelia's 'You are our pride, and...' continues in Schneizel's 'And our dream!' (kept as a split sentence).
752:t_2:100/101/102, 72-75: 'they/them' referents (彼等) left as plural they, group = the fighting team per scene.
uncertain: 752:t_2:88: speaker Dorothy token chosen as #pt101 (Gundam Wing Dorothy Catalonia, per library_retoken.json), not #pt319/#bigo.
752:t_2:34: Bebel's 姉さん rendered 'Sis' (his sister Amy, Gargantia; she is addressed, not a speaker here); Ledo addressed as plain Ledo.
752:t_2:42 / 52: Shiro's アニキ = 'Big Bro' (Kouji Kabuto, inferred); Sachiko's お兄ちゃん = 'Big Bro' (Kappei, inferred).
752:t_2:12: Marina's 'あなた達…$cが…' written 'If we have you... If we have $c with us, then...' (does not assume $c singular/plural).
752:t_2:26: Billy's 君達に全てを託す written with 'I' (singular speaker; other rows in this chorus use we).
752:t_2:16/18/19/32: ZONE, Leyline, Wrath Babylon, Spirit Quanta Absorption System, Blue/Green Earth written as glossary tokens; 蒼と翠の地球 split into two tokens joined by 'and'.
752:t_2:20: 地球の次元力 uses the proposed keyword token (Earth's Dimensional Power) although no 《》 link is present.
752:t_2:35: Kiyal's 大グレン団 kept as the $$大グレン団$$ token (not 超グレン団), as in the Japanese.
